**Womancart** -- Q2FY27 revenue up 26.3% YoY to Rs 35.9 cr, PAT up 37.0% to Rs 4.3 cr; H1FY27 revenue up 37.4% to Rs 68.4 cr, PAT up 52.6% to Rs 8.1 cr.
